title: Focus model rewrite — component-based focus on Interactive
description:
Replace index-based focused_child_index with FocusManager on Interactive.

## Problem
pi-mono has TUI.setFocus(component) with Focusable interface + overlay save/restore. zi has index-based focused_child_index on Container + manual editor.focused toggle. Blocks editor swap, overlay push/pop, selector focus.

## Design (oracle-reviewed)
- FocusManager struct on Interactive (not Container)
- Component identity via ptr field (NOT vtable — vtable is shared per type)
- Add setFocused/isFocused to Component vtable
- FocusManager owns: current focused, setFocus, cursorState, handleInput routing
- Container.focused_child_index becomes internal widget concern only
- Input routing through FocusManager, not hardcoded self.editor.handleInput
- Cursor from FocusManager.cursorState, not root.cursorState

## Contract (from docs/extension-ui-contract.md)
- setEditorComponent needs setFocus(newEditor) after swap
- select/input/editor temporary UIs need focus capture + restore
- overlay push/pop needs focus save/restore
- non-capturing overlays shown without stealing focus

## Blocks
- H (overlay system)
- Editor swap for extensions

## References
- pi-mono: .references/pi-mono/packages/tui/src/tui.ts:281-404
- contract: docs/extension-ui-contract.md section F

title: Overlay system — handle-based, cell-buffer composited
description:
Add overlay stack to Interactive with handle-based lifecycle and cell-buffer compositing.

## Problem
pi-mono has TUI.showOverlay with rich OverlayOptions + OverlayHandle. zi has no overlay system. Blocks extension custom UIs, future model/session selectors.

## Design (oracle-reviewed)
Overlay stack on Interactive:

    const OverlayEntry = struct {
        id: u64,
        component: Component,
        options: OverlayOptions,
        pre_focus: ?Component,
        hidden: bool,
        non_capturing: bool,
        focus_order: u64,
    };

OverlayOptions (parity with pi-mono):
- width/minWidth/maxHeight (absolute or percentage)
- anchor (center, top-left, top-right, bottom-left, etc)
- offsetX/offsetY, row/col
- margin (per-side or uniform)
- visible fn(w,h)→bool for dynamic visibility
- nonCapturing flag

OverlayHandle methods:
- hide() — permanent remove
- setHidden(bool) — temporary toggle
- focus()/unfocus()
- isFocused()/isHidden()

## Rendering (zi-specific advantage)
Cell-buffer compositing: render root tree into buffer first, then render each visible overlay into sub-region on top. Simpler than pi-mono's line-splice approach.

## Focus rules
- Show: save preFocus, setFocus(overlay) unless nonCapturing
- Hide: focus topmost visible capturing overlay, or restore preFocus
- Invisible overlay (terminal resize): redirect focus

## Depends on
- F (focus model) — overlay focus save/restore uses FocusManager

## References
- pi-mono: .references/pi-mono/packages/tui/src/tui.ts:74-404
- contract: docs/extension-ui-contract.md section H
close_reason: shipped: OverlayManager + TUI.showOverlay/hideOverlay, OverlayHandle with focus/unfocus/isFocused, cell-buffer compositing, anchor positioning, focus_order render sorting

title: Transcript model — generic TranscriptItem with metadata
description:
Replace closed TranscriptRow union with generic TranscriptItem struct.

## Problem
pi-mono chatContainer is a flat Container accepting any Component (8+ types). zi Transcript has closed union with 3 types. Extensions can't inject CustomMessage, BashExecution, CompactionSummary, Spacers, etc.

## Design (oracle-reviewed)
Single model, not hybrid union:

    const TranscriptItem = struct {
        component: Component,
        owned: ?*ManagedComponent = null,
        kind: TranscriptItemKind = .generic,
        tool_call_id: ?[]const u8 = null,
    };

Keep transcript-owned scrolling/rendering. Keep tool lookup HashMap. Keep current_text_idx for streaming merge. Make row storage uniform — built-in types become convenience constructors.

Add container-like mutation APIs:
- addComponent(comp) — append generic
- removeComponent(comp) — by identity
- clearAll() — session reset

## Why not full generic Container
zi's cell buffer renderer requires transcript-owned scroll math. pi-mono's TUI handles scroll at top level (viewport bottom N lines). zi can't adopt that model.

## Why not hybrid union
Oracle: 'typed rows + generic escape hatch' creates two competing models. Built-in types don't benefit from being union branches — tool lookup uses HashMap, scroll uses height accounting. Both independent of union shape.

## Contract (from docs/extension-ui-contract.md)
- setMessageRenderer → custom message types in chat
- arbitrary Component injection for extensions

## References
- pi-mono: .references/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/interactive-mode.ts:2591-2670
- contract: docs/extension-ui-contract.md section G

title: abort does not stop streaming: signal not checked in SSE loop
description:
root cause: abort_requested flag is passed as signal through to stream_options.base.signal, but no provider checks it. anthropic.zig has zero references to signal. the SSE reader loops until the server closes the connection.

pi-mono abort works because JS AbortSignal is wired into fetch — when signaled, the TCP connection is killed and the SSE stream throws.

fix: check abort flag in the SSE read loop (src/ai/sse.zig or src/ai/anthropic.zig). when flag is set, close the HTTP connection and return with stop_reason=aborted.

the signal is passed as ?*anyopaque pointing to a bool. cast and check between SSE chunks.

title: kitty protocol negotiation: query response + enable + fallback
description:
root cause of shift+enter not working: kitty protocol is never activated.

zi sends the query (CSI ? u) but never intercepts the response or calls enableKittyProtocol(). the parser (parseKey) correctly handles CSI u format when kitty_active=true, but kitty_active is always false.

fix: implement the negotiation lifecycle:
1. send query CSI ? u
2. intercept response CSI ? <flags> u in raw input
3. if matched → send CSI > 7 u (enable all flags), set kitty_active=true
4. timeout (~150ms) → fall back to xterm modifyOtherKeys mode 2
5. on exit → send CSI < u to pop

also need:
- filter release events (event type 3) when kitty active
- map functional codepoints 57399-57426 (zi-4r0)

references:
- spec: https://sw.kovidgoyal.net/kitty/keyboard-protocol/
- pi-mono: .references/pi-mono/packages/tui/src/terminal.ts:127-193
- ghostty: src/terminal/kitty/key.zig (flag stack model)

title: Threading & allocator ownership refactor (neovim-style)
description: Adopt single-owner-per-resource + message-passing architecture for zi's threading model. Two crashes exposed the current fragility: (1) lua_newthread called on main L while a coroutine was running, (2) concurrent ArenaAllocator access from agent+TUI threads. Band-aided with Coroutine.initFrom and std.heap.ThreadSafeAllocator. This epic removes the band-aids and adopts the textbook pattern: lua_State pinned to agent thread, per-thread arenas, shared GPA for cross-thread payloads, state mutations routed through queues. Render paint stays push-snapshot (already works via pending_renders). Agent event-loop refactor is deferred to a separate epic.
design: See oracle review in session 2026-04-06. Five-phase plan: (1) audit+soft-trace, (2) explicit lua owner bind + hard assert, (3) per-domain arenas + shared allocator for queues, (4) AgentRequest queue for state-mutating actions, (5) cleanup stale docs. Deferred: agent poll/kqueue loop, spawn stdio fold, anthropic watchdog removal.
notes: Read .zi/design-notes/threading-doctrine.md before starting any task in this epic. It is prescriptive — if it disagrees with a bead description, the doctrine wins. Covers: target architecture, owner table, sequencing rules (R1-R5), oracle corrections to the original plan, traps, per-phase verification, when to consult oracle.

description: Mirror of EventQueue in the opposite direction. Variants: resume_session (path), switch_model (model_id), run_slash_command (name, args), login_event (progress/auth). Agent thread drains in its main dispatch; TUI thread enqueues and either fires-and-forgets or waits on a completion slot. Document the contract in design-notes. Render stays push-snapshot — do NOT add a render request variant.

title: Route /resume through AgentRequest queue

Enqueue AgentRequest.resume_session(path) instead; agent thread handles the actual loading and publishes a session_loaded event back via event_queue for TUI to refresh. Preserves agent ownership of session_store and ca.agent.state.
close_reason: Landed in ce1469c. One thread fn, drain_only worker on idle, /resume blocked during streaming, dedicated completion event, text-only parity. zi-wub.24/.25/.26 filed for rich payload, model restore, cwd read cleanup.

title: Route /model through AgentRequest queue

title: Route login thread callbacks through event_queue

Change the callbacks to push UiEvent.login_progress / UiEvent.login_done onto event_queue; TUI thread consumes them from the normal dispatch path. Single-owner invariant restored for status_text.

title: Add soft thread-id tracing to assertOnLuaThread

title: Add bindLuaOwnerThread(agent_tid) called at agent-thread start

Called from the agent-thread entry point (interactive.agentThreadFn and any other entry) immediately upon spawn, pinning the runner's lua_owner_tid atomic. Must happen BEFORE the first lua call. Replaces the current first-touch cmpxchg claim.

title: Replace first-touch lua owner claim with explicit bind
description: Remove the cmpxchgStrong(0, tid, ...) fallback in assertOnLuaThread. After phase 2.1 lands, the owner is always set explicitly. Any call to assertOnLuaThread with an unset owner is a bug (misconfigured runner). Panic loudly in that case.

title: Flip wrong-thread lua access to fatal in debug builds
description: assertOnLuaThread compares runtime tid to bound owner tid. On mismatch, in Debug/ReleaseSafe: @panic with a message naming both tids and the call site. In ReleaseFast: log and continue (or unreachable — decide during implementation). Requires phase 1 audit complete and phase 2.1/2.2 landed so no known violator remains.
close_reason: assertOnLuaThread panics on wrong-thread access in safe builds. closes phase 2.

title: Introduce shared thread-safe GPA for cross-thread payloads & queue storage

Oracle flagged that step 3 must include queue storage — EventQueue.items calls ArrayListUnmanaged.append on the producer thread, not just payloads.
